import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/training_6.csv"
]

# Columns in the target schema and their types (for reference)
target_columns = [
    'Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
    'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage',
    'TouchSnapPercentage', 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints',
    'FantasyPointSnapPercentage'
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are in the target schema order
    # The source schema matches target schema exactly in column names and order except 'Name' and 'Rank' positions swapped
    # Source schema: ['Rank', 'Name', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame', 'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage', 'TouchSnapPercentage', 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints', 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage']
    # Target schema: ['Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame', 'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage', 'TouchSnapPercentage', 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints', 'FantasyPointSnapPercentage']
    # So we reorder columns accordingly:
    df = df[['Name', 'Rank', 'Team', 'Position', 'Played', 'SnapsPlayed', 'SnapsPerGame',
             'SnapsPlayedPercentage', 'RushSnapPercentage', 'TargetSnapPercentage',
             'TouchSnapPercentage', 'IntendedTouchSnapPercentage', 'FantasyPoints',
             'FantasyPointSnapPercentage']]
    dfs.append(df)

# According to operation_history, perform UNION of all source tables
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_25/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
